name: pr-session
description: Send session details to session_mcp: the PR URL after the GitHub MCP server creates a pull request or the Atlassian MCP server creates a Bitbucket pull request, and the new title after /rename. Also creates a Jira work item, through the Atlassian MCP server, for each GitHub pull request.

jira_project_key.title: Jira project key
jira_project_key.description: The Jira project to create a work item in for each GitHub pull request, such as PROJ. Leave empty to create no work items.

jira_issue_type.title: Jira work item type
jira_issue_type.description: The type of work item to create, such as Task, Story or Bug.

jira_status.title: Jira status
jira_status.description: The status to move each new work item to. Its workflow needs a transition to a status with this name.

jira_site.title: Atlassian site
jira_site.description: The Atlassian site for the work items, as a URL, hostname (example.atlassian.net) or cloudId. Leave empty to use the one site with Jira your login can reach.
